purpose: Form PAS-6 relates to the issuance and management of securities in dematerialised form by unlisted public companies.
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Apply to a depository to facilitate dematerialisation of all existing securities.
Secure an International Security Identification Number for each type of security.
Inform all existing security holders about the dematerialisation facility.
checklist: Ensure timely payment of admission and annual fees to the depository and registrar.
Maintain a security deposit of not less than two years' fees with the depository and registrar at all times.
Comply with regulations, directions, guidelines, or circulars issued by the Securities and Exchange Board or Depository.
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
